slides.title: Intro
body: Glad to be on this project. My name is Damir, I’m a director from Tashkent, and I’ve been directing commercials since 2019. I know this story very well, and I know these people. I was born here and grew up with them.
MG is a brand with a long history. It was born in Britain about a hundred years ago. For me, it’s a great challenge: to tell the story of a British brand in an Uzbek way.

slides.title: The main idea
slides.lead: How people see a car all over the world

slides.title: The main idea
slides.lead: How your relatives in Uzbekistan see a car
callouts: “The main thing is that it’s reliable”
“The main thing is that we can drive to the mountains”
“I need a big boot to go to the bazaar”

slides.title: The value of the idea
slides.lead: The value of the idea is that we understand what each family member needs, and the car can cover it.
table: “The main thing is that it’s reliable”
“I need a big boot to go to the bazaar”
“The main thing is that we can drive to the mountains”

slides.title: The value of the idea
slides.text: The “Everyone likes MG” concept itself is really great. The campaign can be scaled: within this creative idea we can come up with many films and situations.

slides.title: The value of the idea
slides.text: All my directing will make sure every scene works for this idea.

slides.title: Approach
slides.text: To create a comedy where every person in Uzbekistan recognizes themselves and believes the story.

slides.title: Culture truth
body: Our people are very direct and say things as they are. Especially within the family.
The older generation is very careful when it comes to serious purchases.
That’s why our story shows the arc so well: from careful — to curious — to action.

slides.title: How MG sounds
body: We hear “MG” many times in the film. It’s great, and it’s a proven way to make people remember.
But here’s the question: how do we say “MG”?
I suggest adding a dramatic arc to the way this phrase is said.
How the phrase is said matters. The way it is said changes, and that is how we understand that the viewer is gradually moving to the brand’s side.

slides.title: Animatic: the pre-shoot
body: We shot this test ourselves to make the directing, the humour, the dynamics and the camera angles clear. Our crew stood in for the actors, and we did not use the film’s cars or locations.
We recreated only the first scene of the film and showed it at a free pace, not tied to the timing of the animatic.

slides.title: Animatic: characters and locations
body: This is the same animatic. Now let’s imagine where it happens and with whom.

slides.title: S01_1
slides.cap: Crane shot. The red ZS drives into the hovli and rolls to the centre of the yard. Hearing the car, the father, the mother and Grandpa start coming out of the house. In the back, a wall covered with grapevine.
slides.name: Driving into the hovli

slides.title: Hovli
slides.text: A hovli is a traditional Uzbek house with a courtyard. Every Uzbek recognizes it instantly.

slides.title: S01_2
slides.cap: Medium shot, slightly from below. Grandpa, the mother and the father have come out and stand close together, the father in front. They all look left, at the car. Eyebrows up, curious faces, no polite smiles.
slides.name: The family comes out

slides.title: S01_3a
slides.cap: Extreme wide, low, front three-quarter. We see the whole ZS and, behind it, the gate they came through. A small vegetable garden on the left, the house on the right. The daughter gets out of the driver’s door, her husband on the other side: we see him over the roof. Behind the car, the title “MG ZS”. Camera: push in on the daughter.
slides.name: The daughter gets out

slides.title: S01_3b
slides.cap: End of the push-in, medium shot. The daughter leans on the open door and tells the family the news. She gives her husband a quick wink: he is behind the car on the left and smiles back. Bottom left: the bonnet and the windscreen.
slides.name: The news and a wink

slides.title: S01_4
slides.cap: Same angle as when the family came out, only tighter. Grandpa on the left, the mother in the centre, the father large on the right. They all look left, at the car. The father asks a short “MG?”, careful curiosity on their faces.
slides.name: “MG?”

slides.title: S02
slides.cap: Close-up at grille height. The MG badge on the left, the daughter crouching on the right. She points at the badge with her open hand and tells the family about it. Camera: whip pan left.
slides.name: The badge

slides.title: S03
slides.cap: End of the same pan. Now the badge is on the right; on the left Grandpa has crouched down, one hand on the grille. He squints at the badge, and a pleased smile appears: the brand is older than him.
slides.name: Grandpa at the badge

slides.title: S04A
slides.cap: High angle from behind, over the yard; the ZS tailgate at the bottom of the frame. The daughter and her husband stand by the car on the left, the father closer to the bonnet. On the right the mother walks around the car to the boot: chin slightly up, hands clasped. Camera: crane down to the boot.
slides.name: Mother walks to the boot

slides.title: S04B
slides.cap: Low angle from behind, at boot height. The mother on the right, hands on her hips, looks at the tailgate. The tailgate is just starting to rise. Behind her it is still the yard.
slides.name: Mother at the boot

slides.title: S05_a
slides.cap: The camera is inside the boot, looking out. The dark opening frames the shot, and outside it is already the bazaar: canopies, melons. The daughter puts a basket and a box right in front of the lens, the mother looks in from the left. Camera: dolly out, deeper into the boot.
slides.name: From the boot: the bazaar

slides.title: S05_b
slides.cap: Same axis after the dolly out. The shopping is still there, and between it and the camera there is a lot of free floor. The women in the opening look smaller. The daughter reaches for the tailgate to close it.
slides.name: Still plenty of room

slides.title: S06
slides.cap: Close-up. The daughter has closed the boot; she looks up and searches for her family on the right. Her smile freezes: nobody is there, just an empty car park by the bazaar. Sound lines from the boot: the doors have slammed (we hear it). We don’t see the father at the wheel yet.
lines: How do you like my MG?
slides.name: Nobody around

slides.title: S07_a
slides.cap: Frontal, through the windscreen. The whole family is already in the car: the father at the wheel on the right, Grandpa next to him, the mother and the daughter’s husband in the back. They exchange looks; the father has a pleased grin. Camera: pan right.
slides.name: The family is already in the car

slides.title: S07_b
slides.cap: End of the pan: the driver’s window and the mirror. Outside, the daughter leans to her father and can’t believe her eyes. The father answers with a smile, the mother laughs in the back.
slides.name: The daughter at the window

slides.title: S07_inside
slides.cap: Through the ZS cabin: Grandpa and the father at the wheel in the foreground. Outside the driver’s window, the daughter leans in and can’t believe the family is leaving without her.
slides.name: From inside the cabin

slides.title: S07_c
slides.cap: Wide shot at the bazaar car park. The ZS drives off to the right, half of it already out of frame. The daughter stands alone in the middle, arms down, watching it go with her mouth open.
slides.name: The family drives off

slides.title: S08a
slides.cap: Close-up of the ZS screen: a contact icon, “Neighbor” and “Calling...”. On the left, the steering wheel and a hand, out of focus. The call is on speaker.
slides.name: Calling the neighbour

slides.title: S08
slides.cap: The father at the wheel, in profile from the passenger side. Both hands on the wheel, eyes on the road. He happily tells the neighbour about the car. Outside the window, a mahalla street.
slides.name: The father at the wheel

slides.title: Situation 2
slides.sub: MG HS · the neighbour and his son

slides.title: S09
slides.cap: Medium shot in another hovli. In the foreground the neighbour waters the yard with a hose, phone at his ear, he can’t hear well. Behind him, at the gate, a grey HS honks. The neighbour starts to turn around.
slides.name: The neighbour with a hose

slides.title: S10
slides.cap: Wide shot, the HS in the yard, front three-quarter. The son stands by the open door and points at the car. The gate in the distance. Behind the car, the title “MG HS”. Camera: push in on the son.
slides.name: The son arrives

slides.title: S10_b
slides.cap: End of the push-in. The son, by the open door of the HS, presents the car. The title “MG HS” behind him stays and grows together with the background.
slides.name: The son presents the car

slides.title: S11
slides.cap: The camera is inside the HS, looking through the driver’s window; the door and the edge of the steering wheel frame the shot. Outside: the son on the left, the father on the right, both looking into the cabin. The father raises an eyebrow and pictures the car on a mountain road.
slides.name: Father and son at the window

slides.title: S12A
slides.cap: Wide drone shot. Mountains, below them the road and the Charvak reservoir. The HS is small, but its shape reads clearly on the bend.
slides.name: Charvak from the drone

slides.title: S12B
slides.cap: Drone over a mountain river: it winds between the rocks and flows into the reservoir. Ridges in the distance. No car in the shot. Camera: drone, slow move forward.
slides.name: Mountain river

slides.title: BR_river
slides.cap: Uzbekistan’s nature as separate B-roll between the driving shots.
slides.name: B-roll: the river

slides.title: BR_charvak
slides.cap: Uzbekistan’s nature as separate B-roll between the driving shots.
slides.name: B-roll: Charvak

slides.title: S12C
slides.cap: Frontal, through the windscreen, the HS in motion. The son, on the left in the passenger seat, points at the road; the father is at the wheel on the right. The space between them is empty.
slides.name: Father and son on the road

slides.title: S13
slides.cap: Same shot as S12C. Only now we see the mother between the seats: she sits in the back, leans forward and asks about safety. The men drive on as if nothing has happened.
slides.name: Mother in the back seat

slides.title: S14_a
slides.cap: The mother’s POV from the back seat. On the left, the father’s shoulder and the steering wheel; on the right, the son has turned around and points at the screen. The screen already shows the airbag diagram. Camera: push in to the screen.
lines: 7 подушек безопасности и Pilot ADAS — MG.
slides.name: The son points at the screen

slides.title: S14_b
slides.cap: Close-up of the HS screen: the car seen from above and seven marked airbags. The son’s finger enters the frame from the right.
slides.name: Seven airbags

slides.title: S14_c
slides.cap: Straight from above. The HS drives in the middle lane of a three-lane road in the foothills. Graphics along the road markings show how the car keeps its lane.
slides.name: Lane keeping

slides.title: S15_hood
slides.cap: Close-up: the son runs his hand over the bonnet of the HS. The sunset reflects in the paint.
slides.name: A hand on the bonnet

slides.title: S15
slides.cap: Medium shot in the mountains at sunset. The son on the right, the reservoir and the ridges behind him. He opens his hands and waits for an answer. On the left, the doors slam (we hear it).
slides.name: The son in the mountains

slides.title: S16
slides.cap: Wide shot in the mountains at sunset. The HS drives away: the father at the wheel, the mother in the back. The son is left alone in the middle of the empty space and spreads his hands.
lines: Now, off to the chaykhana — MG!
slides.name: The father drives away

slides.title: S17
slides.cap: High wide shot at the chaykhana: a carved ayvan terrace, tapchans with tea, a car park. Three friends stand with their backs to us. The HS drives straight up to them, the father alone at the wheel.
slides.name: The chaykhana

slides.title: S17b_a
slides.cap: Medium close-up. At the edges of the frame, the backs of two friends’ heads; between them, the father by his HS. He proudly takes the compliment.
slides.name: The compliment

slides.title: S17b_b
slides.cap: Same composition a second later. The father hears another car arriving and looks past the camera to the right. His smile turns into surprise. The friends turn all the way round to look too.
slides.name: Another car arrives

slides.title: S18
slides.cap: Low angle from wheel level, front three-quarter. A black MG5 with fully tinted windows. The owner stands by the driver’s door, his hand on the roof. Behind the car, the title “MG5”. Camera: dolly in, rising.
slides.name: The MG5 arrives

slides.title: S18_b
slides.cap: End of the dolly-in. The owner leans on the roof of the MG5 and smiles, pleased. The title “MG5” behind him stays and grows together with the background.
slides.name: The MG5 owner

slides.title: S19
slides.cap: Low, along the side of the MG5. On the right, glossy doors reflecting the group. Three friends walk up to the car; the big one leans to the window and checks how much room there is.
slides.name: The friends walk up

slides.title: S20_a
slides.cap: Slightly from above, from the passenger side. All the doors open at once: the big friend and the friend in glasses get in the back, the curly-haired one in the front. The owner is still standing outside. Camera: pan along the car.
slides.name: Everyone gets in

slides.title: S20_b
slides.cap: The cabin from the front. Big men sit comfortably: there is room at the knees and above the heads. The curly-haired friend has stretched his legs; the big one in the back spreads his hands, pleased.
slides.name: Room in the cabin

slides.title: S22
slides.cap: Through the open driver’s door. The owner gets behind the wheel, presses a button on the side of the seat, and the seat slides back. The big friend in the back leans forward.
slides.name: The seat slides back

slides.title: S23
slides.cap: The cabin from the passenger side. The owner, at the wheel on the left, has turned to his friends, his arm on the seatback, and asks the question. The friends lean towards him.
slides.name: The owner’s question

slides.title: S24
slides.cap: Wide shot at the chaykhana. The MG5 drives off, the owner at the wheel. Happy faces in the open windows; the friends answer all together. The ayvan behind them, dust at the wheels.
lines: Take us for a ride — MG!
slides.name: They all drive off

slides.title: S25
slides.cap: Pack shot. Three cars stand side by side, front three-quarter: the red ZS, the grey HS, the black MG5. Mountains in the distance; the upper left of the sky is left free for graphics.
lines: Everyone likes MG. 5 years or 150,000 km warranty.
Всем понравится MG. Гарантия — 5 лет или 150 000 км.
slides.name: Pack shot

slides.title: Titles over the video
body: The film has three parts: three car models. I think each car’s opening should be striking and split the film into three separate parts.
That’s why these shots are always a hero shot: the car looks beautiful and big, and behind the people a big title with the model name hangs in the air.
Text can also be modest, describing the car’s features: the boot, the driver-assistance system and so on.

slides.title: Real shooting
body: I suggest shooting the driving part for real, with no CG. This way people will see that the car exists and will recognize the views of our city and our nature.
In the drone shots I suggest using no AI and no CG at all, so that everything looks natural.
Our mountains have crazy views. There are not many rivers at this time of year, but we can put shots of Uzbekistan’s nature as separate B-roll between the driving shots.
We shoot with a car rig, a drone and so on.
pic: The MG HS driving above Charvak

slides.title: Hybrid production
body: All the other shots we shoot hybrid.
I suggest a hybrid instead of a fully AI film: we shoot with the approved actors and the angles we need, and simply replace the background.
It is hybrid AI with background replacement that gives us realism, unlike full AI.
Our film is very large in scale. To optimize the shooting days, I suggest shooting part of it against background plates.
loop: An example of hybrid production by Lunar Production
slides.piccap: Top: the studio shoot. Bottom: the result · Lunar Production

slides.title: Production
slides.text: Using AI selectively together with real shooting lets us fit the whole film and the adaptations into 2 shooting days. We can also shoot everything without AI, but that would most likely take 3–4 shooting days.

slides.title: Production
slides.text: With this balance of AI and real shooting we get a convincing, high-quality film that we can really shoot without a huge number of shooting days.

slides.title: Preparation / Scout
body: As you can see, I like to prepare carefully for my films: I shoot tests and pre-shoots, so that everything is clear.

Same here. Before we spend hours filming the car driving through the mountains with a camera mounted on it, I plan to drive my own car with a mini camera first and pick the locations with exact angles.
So instead of a general “we’ll shoot in the mountains”, you will know the angles in advance.
The mini camera is only for the test scout. The film itself we shoot on an Alexa from a car rig.

slides.title: Adaptations
body: Besides the 60-second master, we have 30- and 15-second versions and the 9:16 and 4:5 formats.

The short versions have three scenes that are not in the 60: the daughter’s father and 170 hp for the ZS, the little brother and the panoramic sunroof for the HS, a friend and the 360° cameras for the MG5.
I take the short versions as seriously as the master: the humour has to work in them too.

cols.name: The father sizes up the ZS
cols.cap: The father looks over the red ZS and then at his daughter. There is a friendly challenge in his question.

cols.name: The daughter at the wheel
cols.cap: The daughter answers from the driver’s seat. Her father is next to her; her husband, mother and grandpa ride in the back.

cols.name: The red ZS on the move
cols.cap: As the line continues, the red ZS picks up speed on a green city street.

cols.name: The little brother looks around the cabin
cols.cap: The little brother settles into the back seat and looks with curiosity at his older brother in the front.

cols.name: The older brother opens the sunroof
cols.cap: From the front passenger seat the older brother presses the sunroof switch. The little one follows his hand.

cols.name: The panoramic roof is open
cols.cap: From above, through the open sunroof, we see the brothers. The little one looks up and smiles.

cols.name: The friend in glasses asks
cols.cap: In the back seat the friend in glasses turns to the owner and asks about safety.

cols.name: The 360° cameras
cols.cap: The owner switches on the surround view. The display shows the black MG5 from above, the lines of the parking space and the camera image.

slides.title: Rahmat! Thank You
slides.text: I’ll be glad to get your feedback and questions, and to keep improving the film.
